must_have_properties: Every MODBUS PDU shall start with a 1-byte Function Code in range 1..255 (0 is invalid).
Exception responses shall have Function Code = (original Function Code) OR 0x80, followed by a 1-byte Exception Code.
PDU length shall not exceed 253 bytes regardless of transport.
Modbus RTU ADU shall not exceed 256 bytes (= 1-byte address + ≤253 PDU + 2-byte CRC).
Modbus ASCII ADU shall use ':' (0x3A) as start-of-frame, 2-ASCII-hex character encoding, LRC error check, and CR LF as end-of-frame.
Modbus TCP ADU shall not exceed 260 bytes (= 7-byte MBAP + ≤253 PDU); MBAP.Protocol_ID = 0x0000; MBAP.Length = 1 + len(PDU).
All multi-byte numerical quantities on the wire shall be big-endian (most significant byte first).
PDU addresses are zero-based; a user-facing data item numbered X is at PDU address X-1.
Server validation order shall be: Function Code → Data Address → Data Value → Execute (per Figure 9).
Server shall not respond to a broadcast request (Address = 0 on serial transports).
Server shall silently discard frames that fail framing (CRC / LRC / parity / Protocol ID) checks; no exception response is sent.
FC 0x05 Write Single Coil shall accept only Output Value = 0xFF00 (ON) or 0x0000 (OFF); other values shall return exception 0x03.
FC 0x01 / 0x02 quantity per request shall be 1..2000 (0x07D0).
FC 0x03 / 0x04 quantity per request shall be 1..125 (0x007D).
FC 0x0F quantity per request shall be 1..1968 (0x07B0).
FC 0x10 quantity per request shall be 1..123 (0x007B).
FC 0x17 read quantity 1..125 + write quantity 1..121.
FC 0x18 returned FIFO count shall be ≤ 31 (0x1F).
FC 0x16 Mask Write Register shall compute Result = (Current AND AND_Mask) OR (OR_Mask AND (NOT AND_Mask)) and write it back atomically.
FC 0x2B Encapsulated Interface Transport shall include a 1-byte MEI Type after the function code; 0x0D = CANopen, 0x0E = Read Device Identification.
FC 0x2B / MEI 14 Read Device Identification shall support at least the Basic conformity level — the three mandatory objects VendorName (0x00), ProductCode (0x01), MajorMinorRevision (0x02).

Diagnostic counters (Bus Message Count, Bus Comm Error Count, Bus Exception Error Count, Server Message Count, Server No Response Count, Server NAK Count, Server Busy Count, Bus Character Overrun Count) shall be readable via FC 0x08 sub-codes 11..18.
must_not_have_properties: Function code 0 shall never be transmitted as a valid request.

Function codes in Annex A reserved ranges (FC 9, 10, 13, 14, 41, 42, 90, 91, 125..127; FC 8 sub-codes 19, 21..65535; FC 43 sub-MEI 0..12 and 15..255) shall not be implemented by interoperable devices.
MBAP.Protocol_ID != 0 shall not be sent by a MODBUS-conforming device.
FC 7, 8, 11, 12, 17 shall not be used on Modbus TCP — they are serial-line-only.
Server shall not respond to its own broadcast frames.
Server shall not echo a corrupted request as if it were valid; silent discard on CRC/LRC error is required.
FC 0x05 Output Value of anything other than 0xFF00 / 0x0000 shall not produce a normal response.
MBAP fields shall not be re-ordered (Transaction ID, Protocol ID, Length, Unit ID is the only legal sequence).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Server receives FC it does not implement → exception 0x01 ILLEGAL FUNCTION.
Server receives a read/write whose addressed items partly fall outside its data tables → exception 0x02 ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: Quantity / Byte Count out of range
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Quantity exceeds per-FC max (e.g. > 2000 for FC 1/2, > 125 for FC 3/4, > 1968 for FC 0x0F, > 123 for FC 0x10), or Byte Count != ceil(N/8) / 2N → exception 0x03 ILLEGAL DATA VALUE.
Output Value ∉ {0xFF00, 0x0000} → exception 0x03 ILLEGAL DATA VALUE.
Memory fault, hardware fault, timeout writing to backing store → exception 0x04 SERVER DEVICE FAILURE.
Programming command queued; reply with exception 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE to prevent client timeout; complete later via Poll Program Complete.
Already executing a long programming command → exception 0x06 SERVER DEVICE BUSY; client should retransmit later.
FC 0x14 / 0x15 over reference-type-6 area whose memory-parity check fails → exception 0x08 MEMORY PARITY ERROR.
Gateway misconfigured / overloaded → exception 0x0A GATEWAY PATH UNAVAILABLE.
Gateway forwarded the request; target sub-device did not reply → exception 0x0B GATEWAY TARGET DEVICE FAILED TO RESPOND.
Parity / framing / CRC / LRC mismatch on serial transport → silent discard; client times out.
MBAP.Protocol_ID != 0, or MBAP.Length doesn't match received PDU length → connection-level error; implementation may close the socket.

modbus_rtu.byte_format: 1 start + 8 data LSB-first + parity (even default; mandatory unless 2 stop bits used instead) + 1 stop bit
modbus_rtu.error_check: CRC-16-Modbus, polynomial 0xA001 (reflected) / 0x8005 (normal), initial value 0xFFFF, low byte transmitted first

modbus_ascii.byte_format: 1 start + 7 data + parity + 1 stop bit (typical) — each PDU byte encoded as 2 ASCII-hex chars

modbus_tcp.concurrent_transactions_per_socket: Limited only by Transaction-ID field width (65536 values)

fields.reset_behavior_compliance: On power-up / reset, the server's diagnostic counters and Comm Event Counter / Log shall be cleared to 0; the four data tables shall hold their implementation-defined power-on defaults; the server shall enter WAIT_FOR_MB_INDICATION state and begin servicing requests once the underlying transport (UART / TCP socket) is ready.
